basic_details.job_title: IIFT Computer Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (IIFT), a Deemed to be University and an autonomous body under the Department of Commerce, Govt. of India, is engaging a Computer Engineer purely on a contract basis for 1 year at its New Delhi Campus, for an all-inclusive consolidated remuneration of Rs. 75,000 – 80,000 per month. Applicants need a BE/B.Tech/M.Sc./MCA/M.Tech or equivalent qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology or Electronics and a minimum of 5 years' experience. Applications are online only, through the link in the notice, latest by 3.12.2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum 40 years as on the last date of receipt of online application. The notice prints no age relaxation. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full conditions of the post.

qualification.details: BE/B.Tech/M.Sc./MCA/M.Tech or equivalent qualification in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics, with good academic record.

how_to_apply: Interested candidates with the required qualification and experience should apply online only, through the application link given in the notice, latest by 3.12.2026. The notice names no documents to be uploaded or enclosed and gives no postal or e-mail address for applications.
important_instructions: Fulfilling the educational qualification and experience conditions does not necessarily entitle an applicant to be called for further process of recruitment. IIFT reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post advertised. No correspondence will be entertained about postal delays, the conduct and result of the interview, or the reason for not being called for interview.

content_sections.heading: IIFT Computer Engineer at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the number of vacancies or the application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Foreign Trade (Deemed to be University)
1 year, purely on contract basis; extendable up to further periods based on performance and requirement of the Institute
All inclusive consolidated Rs. 75,000 – 80,000 per month
Maximum 40 years as on last date of receipt of online application

content_sections.heading: About IIFT
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Foreign Trade is a Deemed to be University and an autonomous body under the Department of Commerce, Govt. of India. The notice is signed by its Registrar, Gaurav Gulati, and refers to the Institute's New Delhi Campus at B-21, Qutab Institutional Area, New Delhi-110016.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: IIFT intends to engage "person/(s)", so the notice does not say how many Computer Engineers will be taken. BE/B.Tech/M.Sc./MCA/M.Tech or equivalent qualification in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics, with good academic record. Minimum 5 years' work experience in managing computer hardware and software. Demonstrative experience of managing a campus network of 500+ nodes. Candidate with suitable certification (CCNA/MCSE/Cyber Security). Maximum 40 years as on the last date of receipt of online application. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The remuneration is all inclusive and consolidated at Rs. 75,000 – 80,000 per month. The engagement is purely contractual for 1 year, and the contract period may be extendable up to further periods based on performance and the Institute's requirement. The selected candidate will have to join duty immediately on receipt of the offer.

content_sections.heading: IIFT Computer Engineer Job Description
content_sections.text: Perform routine checks to ensure hardware and systems are stable and operating efficiently. Respond to users for any computer related issues. Identify and resolve problems as they arise. Work closely with network support staff to identify and take care of network bugs. Maintaining computer networks including VPNs, routers and other physical hardware. Update existing computer equipment so that it will work with new software.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIFT Computer Engineer
content_sections.text: Interested candidates with the required qualification and experience should apply online only, through the application link given in the notice, latest by 3.12.2026. The notice names no documents to be uploaded or enclosed and gives no postal or e-mail address for applications.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: If there is a large number of applicants, IIFT reserves the right to short-list the applications in any manner it considers appropriate, and no reason for rejection is communicated. Only the shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail to appear for the test and interview at the IIFT Campus, B-21, Qutab Institutional Area, New Delhi-110016. The notice gives no date for the test and interview and does not describe their content.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Fulfilling the educational qualification and experience conditions does not necessarily entitle an applicant to be called for further process of recruitment. IIFT reserves the right to fill or not to fill the post advertised. No correspondence will be entertained about postal delays, the conduct and result of the interview, or the reason for not being called for interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIFT Computer Engineer?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 3.12.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is required for IIFT Computer Engineer?
faq.answer: A BE/B.Tech/M.Sc./MCA/M.Tech or equivalent qualification in Computer Science/Information Technology/Electronics with good academic record is required.

faq.question: Q3. How much experience is needed?
faq.answer: A minimum of 5 years' work experience in managing computer hardware and software is needed, along with demonstrative experience of managing a campus network of 500+ nodes.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years as on the last date of receipt of online application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of IIFT Computer Engineer?
faq.answer: The remuneration is all inclusive consolidated Rs. 75,000 – 80,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IIFT Computer Engineer post?
faq.answer: Apply online only, through the link given in the notice, latest by 3.12.2026.

faq.question: Q7. Is the IIFT Computer Engineer post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely on a contract basis for 1 year, and the contract period may be extendable up to further periods based on performance and the Institute's requirement.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Computer Engineer work?
faq.answer: The post is at the New Delhi Campus of IIFT.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Applications may be short-listed, and only the shortlisted candidates are informed by e-mail to appear for the test and interview at the IIFT Campus, B-21, Qutab Institutional Area, New Delhi-110016.

faq.question: Q10. Is any certification desirable?
faq.answer: Yes, a suitable certification such as CCNA, MCSE or Cyber Security is listed as desirable.
